flame: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production animation sprite sheet for a 1-bit black-and-white Playdate cooking game. Exactly EIGHT sequential frames arranged in a strict 4-column by 2-row uniform grid, read left to right then next row. Canvas 1536x768 pixels; each frame cell 384x384. Real transparent alpha background, no background color or checkerboard. Each cell contains ONLY a compact flickering flame cluster to be overlaid ON a burnt hamburger patty; do not draw meat, grill, charcoal, logs, ground, shadows, smoke or UI. Consistent horizontal base at local y=340 and center x=192 in every cell, total cluster width approximately 300px, height about 290px. Three or four large pointed wavy flame tongues with bold BLACK outlines and opaque WHITE centers, occasional black inner tongue shapes; strong simple silhouette readable after reduction to 64x64. Outer transparency, opaque white inside flames. Pure black and white only, no gray, no gradients, no fine texture, no antialias fuzz. Hand-drawn compact retro pixel-art forms. Animate a coherent seamless flicker: tongues stretch, lean, split and reform progressively; no simple translated duplicates; frame 8 naturally returns to frame 1. Maintain identical baseline and overall scale. Generous transparent separation between cells, no grid lines, numbers, labels or words.
bubbles: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production animation sprite sheet for a 1-bit black-and-white Playdate cooking game. Exactly EIGHT sequential frames arranged in a strict 4-column by 2-row uniform grid, read left to right then next row. Canvas 1536x768 pixels; each cell 384x384. Real transparent alpha background, no background color or checkerboard. Each cell contains ONLY a shallow oval ring of sizzling frying-oil bubbles, seen from a low three-quarter side view, for placing UNDER an oval hamburger patty. Do not draw a patty, food, pan, fire, smoke, text or other objects. Same ellipse center local (192,192), outer footprint width 340px and height 140px across all frames. Leave a large transparent ellipse-shaped central hole around 220px wide for the meat to cover. The ring is made of about 10 to 14 separate irregular bubble outlines, small and medium circles in perspective, with bold BLACK strokes and opaque WHITE interiors; a few tiny popping arcs and droplets near the ring. Avoid a solid pool of liquid: mostly transparent center and gaps between bubbles. Pure black and white, no gray or gradients, no fine texture. Forms must read clearly at 72 pixels wide. Eight coherent looping animation phases: bubbles grow, burst into short arcs, disappear and reform in alternating locations; maintain ring footprint and placement, no translated duplicates. Generous transparent separation between cells, no grid lines, labels, words or numbers.
